overall_conclusion: The repository now contains structured retrospective decision narratives for DSY and VRAX in addition to the existing discretion clues across ten benchmarks. They show that theme can override simple news presence, attention can transfer between leaders, uncertainty can defer participation from the first to second pullback, profit cushion can change size, and slippage can immediately change risk posture. No benchmark yet has a verified pre-entry video timestamped context package or complete alternative-candidate set, so the evidence can guide feature design and targeted visual review but cannot define or promote a contextual strategy layer.
